policy.2025: no outcomes, weather features or fits; original enriched-replay gate remains in force
policy.fit: two-output Ridge alpha 20, train-only preprocessing, common fractional score contract
policy.flags: fixed indoor, known outdoor exposure, complete outdoor weather package
policy.following_season: select on 2023, assess 2024; separately record pre-2025 choice from both
policy.limits: examined adaptive development; static city/venue and publication-delay assumptions
policy.promotion: separate research choice only, fallback compact EPA; flags cannot be selected
policy.scope: 2022 initialization, all 544 2023-2024 development games at both horizons
policy.selection: early-week gain >=0.05 against EPA and flags; positive paired 95% lower bound

source.availability: publication buffer is an assumption; current receipt is not historical proof
source.cohort: 2022-2025 regular-season canonical schedule metadata only; no outcomes or fits
source.exposure: fixed indoor zero; outdoor one; retractable/canopy unknown, no postgame roof
source.fields: 2m temperature C; 10m wind magnitude m/s; instantaneous precipitation rate mm/h
source.limits: 600kB metadata/20kB point response; 24MB compressed raw cache; two request workers
source.location: venue city nearest 0.25 degree grid; no stadium measurement claim
source.missing: retain all game/horizon rows, no fallback run or imputed weather
source.rain: rate equivalent, not accumulated hourly precipitation; no rain/snow type or gusts
source.run: latest six-hour run with run +6h10m strictly before prediction cutoff
source.source: NCAR d084001 operational GFS 0.25 degree archive; DOI 10.5065/D65D8PWK
source.valid: nearest three-hour point to kickoff, ties later; maximum 90 minutes offset
source.venue_publication: 2025-05-13; static announced schedule assumption, not archived edition
source.venues: retrospective registry; seven 2025 overrides from preseason NFL announcement

policy.storage: one context delta and prediction panel; reuse original features and raw weather
policy.terms: complete outdoor package: temperature minus 20C, wind m/s, instantaneous rate mm/h
policy.timing: EPA/history and separate horizon fits locked on Tuesday; context-only refresh
policy.unknown: neutral zero for all three terms with shared venue/coverage flags
